title: primals.eco Email Setup  Walk Kevin Through This on northGate
author: chipmunk-easel
summary: Cloudflare Email Routing already handles RECEIVING for primals.eco (MX records live). We need to: (1) create routing rules in CF dashboard, (2) wire SMTP sending, (3) configure membrane-mailer.py with the creds.

step_1_cloudflare_email_routing.description: Configure email addresses in Cloudflare dashboard
actions: 1. Go to Cloudflare Dashboard ? primals.eco ? Email ? Email Routing
3. Add these addresses (forward to your personal email):
gaia@primals.eco ? same destination (or a separate inbox)
4. Enable 'Catch-all' ? forward to your personal email
5. You can add character addresses later:
step_1_cloudflare_email_routing.note: CF Email Routing is FREE for unlimited addresses on free plan

step_2_gmail_send_as.description: Configure Gmail to SEND as tamison@primals.eco
actions: 1. In Gmail, go to Settings ? Accounts ? 'Send mail as' ? 'Add another email address'
4. Uncheck 'Treat as alias' (optional  depends on preference)
5. Gmail will send a verification code to tamison@primals.eco
6. That email arrives via CF routing at your personal inbox
8. Now you can SEND as tamison@primals.eco from Gmail
step_2_gmail_send_as.note: Gmail 'Send mail as' uses Gmail SMTP but shows your custom From address

step_3_app_password_for_chipmunk.description: Create Gmail App Password so the chipmunk can send programmatically
actions: 2. Create new app password, name it 'membrane-mailer'
6. Enter your Gmail address + the app password
8. Send HN email: python3 membrane-mailer.py --neutrino hn-email
